notes.title: Extending the Easter egg hunt
notes.notes: We are extending the Easter egg hunt another five days! Those bunny ears will bounce your cat high into the sky. I would try out our new glide feature. The glide will have your cat landing like a pro. Just press crouch while flying high in the sky.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Easter Eggtravaganza
notes.notes:
Ester the bunny is back in Cat Gets Medieval. The Easter egg hunt has begun. Complete all the Easter egg hunts and you can get the bunny ears that will bounce you high into all the action. 30% off until Monday. Limited time only to earn those bunny ears.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39825878/8e2ad78e4eba55b1990f0e7110ae41402c664926.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39825878/5e54dea506cfadd23c08faf58558671df824980d.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Cat Gets Medieval now with more bugs!
notes.notes: Not those kind of bugs! All manner of critters and creepy crawlers to keep your cat entertained. Next time you walk through a bush you just may see some butterflies. Next time you knock down some barrels you may find roaches or some other kind of bug. Your cat will love them and get some xp. Also in this update is a key binding fix too. Enjoy and watch out something might be buzzing in your path!

notes.title: Santa is back in Cat Gets Medieval
notes.notes:
Cat Gets Medieval is 25% off during the winter sale. You don't want to miss it! Did you know that Santa is back too! A limited time only for Santa and Santa's workshop to be in the game. If you find Santa's workshop and visit him you can unlock a Santa's hat and a special power. Santa's hat has powers too.  We hope you enjoy this holiday fun!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39825878/2189996c255dfaeb6f631f96215326aa19dd0508.png[/img]

notes.title: Fix for Hats on Custom Cats
notes.notes:
The last update introduced a bug where hats were to small on custom created cats.  It's difficult enough to get a cat to wear a hat,  let alone one that doesn't fit.  Enough cats complained so we fixed it.  Sorry for the inconvenience. 

Also,  we added a few more sound effects and fixed a few other small bugs.

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Bug Fix - Boats are no longer Vans
notes.notes: Yep.  One of our stranger boats but we accidentally turned boats into vans.  This is now back to normal,  if you can call anything in this game normal.

notes.title: Cuter Kitties
notes.notes: Hello lovers of cats! Our cats have had an overhaul to be cuter than ever. Midnight and the others had a makeover. You can also create your own adorable fur ball with our cat creator. We have new menu options and optimization in the game. Lastly, we have fixed some bugs in the game and those fixes are in this latest update. Starting November 15th at 6am PST through November 18th at 6am PST this game will be on sale. We hope you have a cat-tastic time!

notes.title: Easter Eggs abound
notes.notes: Our Easter bunnies are back and so is the search for Easter eggs of all kinds. Not just the Easter eggs that come out of the chicken's backside. Maybe you'll find a hidden passage or some hidden reward in our medieval world. You can use the new steam achievements to help you find them.  Let the Easter egg hunt begin!

notes.title: Harmony points now in single player
notes.notes:
Now you can earn harmony points in single player by completing some of main storyline quests and side quests such as Kings quest and Panda Saver quest.

 We also fixed a bug with a raft on Canary Islands.

We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: The Mad Catter Store and Harmony Hats Store has come to Catmelot
notes.notes:
Now you can use your chaos points and candy to buy hats at the Mad Catter store. Each of these hats gives the wearer a unique abliity. You may wonder how to get chaos points. It's really simple just knock over things and make a mess. 

We also have another store called Harmony Hats.  To buy some of these hats you will need harmony points and candy. Each of these hats gives the wearer a unique ability. How do you get harmony points? You like playing this game with friends then you are in luck because you can collect harmony points.  All you have to do is stay close to your friends and help each other complete the quests. This will give you harmony points.

Have fun with these new hats!

notes.title: Create Custom Cats in Cat Gets Medieval
notes.notes:
Express your cat self! Chunky cats, skinny cats, cool cats, and crazy cats, all cats are welcome in Catmelot. The Cat Creator feature is now added to Cat Gets Medieval. You can adjust the body style, fur pattern, color of your cat, eye color,  and create a name for your cat to play in the game. If you want more customization then choose the morpher body style. The morpher body style will  allow you to also adjust the size of the eyes and ears of the cat. This new feature is hours of fun! 

Along with this new feature is some updates to the UI , climbing animation, movement animation and multiplayer network improvements.

notes.title: Patch to Access Dwarf Forge Key
notes.notes: This is a quick patch to fix a bug preventing players from picking up the Dwarf Forge Rune Key.  Also fixed the dwarven mine carts from making the car horn sound effect.... because that was also a thing.

notes.title: Two new task to help find Santa's Workshop
notes.notes: We created two new task in Cat Gets Medieval to help you find Santa's Workshop. Just go talk to Joy in  the castle where the Cat King is at.  Only a six more days left to find Santa's workshop.

notes.title: Santa's Workshop Adventure
notes.notes: This adventure will get you a Santa's hat, a new power, and a new place to explore in Cat Gets Medieval.  You must find Santa's hat by finding all the Christmas trees in the game. This hat is no ordinary hat. It helps your character restore mana, run faster, and is the key to unlocking Santa's workshop. Once you have the hat the adventure takes you into the Santa's workshop where you must save Christmas. If you are successful you will gain a new power. This adventure will only last until January 5, 2023, so don't wait. Join in on the holiday fun!

notes.title: New features and improvement to collision
notes.notes: We added sound effects to clutter and a lower graphic option in the settings. We also improved the collision to random objects and fixed a bug in one of quest in the kingdom.

notes.title: Updates with performance and Lan play
notes.notes: We upgraded to unreal 5 that has improved performance in the game. We also added reticle (crosshairs) for targeting, improved Lan play, and now you are able to unequip hats or weapons.

notes.title: Easter Sale from April 3rd through April 17th
notes.notes:
20% off during the Easter Eggstravaganza event from April 3rd through April 17th. The Easter bunnies are back! Collect all their eggs and gain Candy, XP, and the Magical Bunny ears.

This update also includes improvements to the beginning quests.

notes.notes:
Updates and bug fixes, along with some clarification of quests are here.  In this release we've

- Removed negative magic effects being applied to other players
- Fixed and updated the Sanctuary and other quests for more clarity

notes.notes: Find Santa, an elf, and his reindeer somewhere in the world. Where? Snowbody knows! What could the gifts have in them? Candy, XP, a custom Santa hat(with really cool bonuses), and more, Oh my!

Find the five Christmas trees throughout the lands and gather your gifts before the year comes to a close. For a limited time collect a custom Santa hat!

notes.title: Updates on movement, maps, and quests
notes.notes:
We improved climbing and we changed the walk to auto run. You can still use walk but you will have to select it. We added local maps to each area in the game. To view your local map press [ m] and on your map is a local button in the bottom left-hand side.  When you click the local button, it will show you a local map for the area. We also made small changes to the first few quest in the kingdom.

notes.title: Cats Get into Everything!
notes.notes:
This update contains several fixes to improve collision issues to help players avoid getting stuck or lost on the map. 
It includes the following fixes & improvements

[list]
[*] "Go to Level Start" feature to quickly escape any sticky situation
[*] Updated collision for many meshes to avoid getting stuck
[*] Level optimizations for improved performance on large levels
[*] Multiplayer travel fixes to reduce chance of dropped client connections
[/list]

notes.title: All Good Cats go to Sanctuary
notes.notes:
This update delivers the new Sanctuary area made available once you collect all the keys from the churches and other good NPCs.  The Sanctuary is a peaceful home for cats and kittens alike, but even in Sanctuary, there are problems that need attention.

Also, this update includes improvements to human NPCs.  Humans can now swim, jump and dance when controlled.  There are also more interactable objects and surprises.

notes.title: A Yowl of Ice and Fire
notes.notes:
This major update is packed with new features.
[list]
[*]Two new regions,  Cattegat Viking area and the Badlands, each with new and unique villages, characters and bosses.
[*] Expanded main quest line by 50%.
[*] Many new side quests.
[*] 4 new and unique items in the game like Lokitty's Helmet.
[*] Minimap with Quest indicators.
[*] Emote (Meow) Feature.
[*] Improved child models and added more children to the game.
[*] New quests with riddles, jail breaks and village defenses from enemy invasions.
[*] Substantial improvements to travel by boat.
[*] Improved pathing and substantial improvements to escort quests.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update for April 6th
notes.notes:
This patch release includes the following:

[list]
[*] Quick Reconnect feature for dropped Multiplayer clients
[*] AI improvements vs. long ranged attacks
[*] Several Quest improvements in Sushima
[*] Vegetable Stands in Sushima now simulate physics
[/list]

notes.title: Easter Eggstravaganza
notes.notes:
This update adds Easter Bunnies throughout the land.  Collect all their eggs and gain Candy, XP and the [b]Magical Bunny Ears[/b]!

This update also includes minor quest fixes, and improvements to improve multiplayer connections.

notes.title: Meet the Great Furlin
notes.notes:
There is a lot to learn and do in Cat Gets Medieval.  And now, Furlin is here to help.  We are adding a helpful wizard to guide players through the initial gameplay.  Furlin will provide some initial information on acquiring your first magical items and completing some initial quests to help get your started.

This release also adds some new features like...
[list]
[*] Configurable Graphics Settings
[*] Configurable Mouse Sensitivity and Y-Axis inversion
[*] Character Reset options to allow for multiple playthroughs with your favorite cats
[/list]

Along with some bug fixes...
[list]
[*] Rebalanced some Boss Mobs (Lowering difficulty in initial levels)
[*] Ingame settings not being applied at startup
[*] Some objects not colliding correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Fairies and Firebreath
notes.notes:
This update adds new powers for many of the cats.  It includes...
[list]
[*]Eldritch Spear for Midnight
[*]Summon Fairy for Angel
[*]Fire Breath for Blaze
[*]Rage Burst for Tiger
[*]Ice Breath for Winter
[*]Summon Ice Golem for Winter
[/list]

This release also adds a reset feature that let's you restart a character and play over and over again.  

Along with many fixes, including...
[list]
[*]Some sounds not respecting distance or volume settings
[*]Slight XP rebalancing for some mid and upper level mobs
[*]Players not getting initial quest if they answer incorrectly
[*]Multiplayer clients not spawning at correct spawn point
[*]Multiplayer clients not gaining health or mana from items
[/list]

notes.title: Controller Support and Multiplayer Enhancements are here!
notes.notes: Lots of improvements in this update.  Cat Gets Medieval gets Controller support, Multiplayer nametags, in-game help and lots of quality of life improvements like mouse-scrolling through available weapons.  This patch has lots of bug fixes too.

notes.title: Beta Testing Better Controller support and Multiplayer experience
notes.notes: This beta is released to test in-game controller support and fix multiplayer bugs like spawning at the wrong spawnpoints on travel.

notes.title: Adding Steam Multiplayer, The Thieves Guild and the Wizard's School
notes.notes: Adding Steam Multiplayer, The Thieves Guild  quests and the Wizard's School map with many new areas to explore and quests.  And tons of books to knock over!
